title: 第二十一章 大行门录第二十二章 生爷
content_zh:
“恩公要去彼河大厦？”潭月玥走了后，斐启立即就问道。
“彼河会所在彼河大厦吗？那我是要去一趟啊。”狄九下意识的回了一句，随后想起了斐启和时锦姗应该是来道谢的，又说道，“你们赶紧走吧，这里不是你们常留的地方。”
斐启中的是枪伤，而且他救了斐启之后就被人堵住，可见斐启惹到的人很强，狄九实在不想卷进来。
斐启知道狄九的意思，他再次说道，“对不起恩公，虽然我不知道有没有为你惹到麻烦，我们的罪的人却非同小可。一旦他们得知你救了我，肯定不会放过你。”
狄九心里暗叹，心说我已经惹到麻烦了。
见狄九不说话，斐启再次说道，“如果没有必要，我建议恩公不要去彼河大厦。”
说完这句话，斐启根本就不等狄九询问，主动说道，“我的枪伤就是彼河大厦的主人彼郑生做的，如果不是锦姗及时赶过去，我已死在了彼河大厦。恩公要去的彼河会所就在彼河大厦……”
狄九愈发惊异不定看着斐启，在他获得的前世记忆中，华夏很安全，特别是法制非常健全。况且潭月玥既然要他去彼河会所，那就是说彼河大厦是人人都知道的公共场所啊，怎么会不安全？
时锦姗在一边说道，“启哥说的是真的，彼河大厦是太平擂台所在，如果被人知道你救了启哥，的确是危险。”
狄九心里凝重起来，经历了家族被灭的事情，他不再和之前那样大大咧咧，很多事情，他宁可细心求证。
想到这里，他对时锦姗说道，“时大姐，你去帮我把门关上。斐大哥，不要叫我恩公了，就叫我狄九吧。还有，我想请斐大哥将受伤的原因说一下。”
时锦姗早就想去将门关上，只是狄九没有说话，她不好自作主张。现在狄九说了话，她立即回头将潭杏堂的大门关上。
等时锦姗将大门关上，斐启这才拿出一本古朴的书放在狄九面前说道，“彼郑生想要杀我，就是因为这本大行门录……”
“我可以看看吗？”狄九看着斐启问了一声。
斐启点点头，“恩公请看。”
狄九将这本书翻开看了一下，书中的字不像是用墨印上去的，排版也是竖的。在这本书的第一页就有一个穴位和经脉图介绍，然后详细的写了每一条脉络和每一个穴位的行气方式。
这不是修武功法，和他那本漩火诀居然有些差不多，难道这也是一本道修功法，或者说是修仙功法？
狄九立即按照第一张图的小周天线路尝试了一下，百会立即一凉，一道清晰的气息渗透进去。
狄九赶紧止住了继续尝试的想法，他肯定这和他的漩火诀一般是一本修仙道法，而不是什么武修功法。最让狄九激动的是，这本功法他可以修炼。
无论如何，也要向这两人借阅一下这本书。平息了内心的激动了，狄九放下手中的书，“你继续说吧。”

斐启这才继续说道，“我斐家这本大行门录一直是祖传下来，只是因为我那儿子在一次饮酒中口误，将我斐家有这本门录的事情说出去，结果被彼郑生知道。彼郑生是彼河大厦的主人，也是地下黑拳太平擂台的主人。”
“太平擂台？”狄九疑惑的问了一句。
斐启点点头，“没错，就是太平擂台。这个擂台应该是国内最大的黑拳擂台，就建立在彼河大厦的地下，管理者就是彼河集团的彼郑生。彼河大厦看起来有商务间、健身场所、顶级会所。实际上，真正要遮掩的就是这个地下的太平擂台。”
“这个名字倒是很古怪。”狄九并不奇怪这种地下擂台，济国一样有。唯一不同的是，济国的擂台大部分都是明处，只有极少数才在暗处。
content_en:
"My benefactor is going to Bihe Building?" Fei Qi asked immediately after Tan Yueyue left.
"Is Bihe Club located in Bihe Building? Then I have to go there." Di Jiu replied subconsciously, and then remembered that Fei Qi and Shi Jinshan should have come to say thank you, and said, "You should leave quickly, this is not a place where you usually stay."
Fei Qi suffered a gunshot wound, and he was blocked after he rescued Fei Qi. This shows that the person Fei Qi provoked was very strong, and Di Jiu really didn't want to get involved.
Fei Qi knew what Di Jiu meant, and he said again, "I'm sorry, my benefactor. Although I don't know if I got into trouble for you, our sins are not trivial. Once they know that you saved me, they will definitely not let you go."
Di Jiu sighed inwardly, thinking that I was already in trouble.
Seeing that Di Jiu remained silent, Fei Qi said again, "If it is not necessary, I advise my benefactor not to go to Bihe Building."
After saying this, Fei Qi didn't even wait for Di Jiu to ask, and said proactively, "My gunshot wound was caused by Bi Zhengsheng, the owner of Bihe Building. If Jinshan hadn't rushed over in time, I would have died in Bihe Building. The Bihe Club where my benefactor was going is in Bihe Building..."
Di Jiu looked at Fei Qi with increasing surprise and uncertainty. In the memory of his past life, China was very safe, especially the legal system was very sound. Besides, since Tan Yueyue wants him to go to Bihe Club, that means Bihe Building is a public place that everyone knows. How can it be unsafe?
Shi Jinshan said on the side, "What Brother Qi said is true. Bihe Building is where the Taiping Arena is located. It will indeed be dangerous if anyone knows that you saved Brother Qi."
Di Jiu's heart became serious. After experiencing the destruction of his family, he was no longer as careless as before. He would rather verify many things carefully.
Thinking of this, he said to Shi Jinshan, "Sister Shi, go and close the door for me. Brother Fei, don't call me benefactor, just call me Di Jiu. Also, I would like to ask Brother Fei to tell you the reason for the injury."
Shi Jinshan had long wanted to close the door, but Di Jiu didn't speak, so she couldn't make her own decision. Now that Di Jiu had spoken, she immediately turned back and closed the door of Tanxingtang.
When Jinshan closed the door, Fei Qi took out a simple book and put it in front of Di Jiu and said, "Zheng Sheng wants to kill me because of this Daxingmenlu..."
"Can I take a look?" Di Jiu looked at Fei Qi and asked.
Fei Qi nodded, "My dear benefactor, please take a look."
Di Jiu opened the book and took a look. The words in the book didn't look like they were printed with ink, and the layout was also vertical. On the first page of this book, there is an introduction to acupuncture points and meridians, and then the detailed description of each meridians and the way of moving Qi at each acupuncture point.
This is not a martial arts technique. It is somewhat similar to his Xuanhuo Jue. Could it be that this is also a Tao cultivation technique, or an immortal cultivation technique?
Di Jiu immediately tried the Xiao Zhoutian route in the first picture. Baihui immediately felt cold and a clear breath penetrated into it.
Di Jiu quickly stopped the idea of ​​continuing to try. He was sure that this, like his Xuanhuo Jue, was a method of cultivating immortality, rather than a martial arts method. What excited Di Jiu the most was that he could practice this technique.
No matter what, borrow this book from these two. After calming down his inner excitement, Di Jiu put down the book in his hand and said, "Go on."
Fei Qi then continued, "My Fei family's Daxingmenlu has always been handed down from our ancestors. It was just because my son made a slip of the tongue while drinking and told the story of our Fei family's possession of this diary. As a result, Zhengsheng knew about it. Zhengsheng is the owner of the Bihe Building and the owner of the underground black boxing Taiping Arena."
"Taiping Arena?" Di Jiu asked doubtfully.
Fei Qi nodded, "Yes, it's the Taiping Arena. This arena should be the largest black boxing arena in the country. It is built underground in the Bihe Building. The manager is Bihe Group.The other member of the group, Zheng Sheng. Bihe Building seems to have business rooms, fitness venues, and top clubs. In fact, what really needs to be covered up is this underground Taiping Arena. "
“The name is quite strange. "Di Jiu is not surprised that this kind of underground arena also exists in Jiguo. The only difference is that most of the arenas in Jiguo are in the open, and only a few are in the dark.
